titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Kultura — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: Culture — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Kultura: film, książka, muzyka, święta, muzeum. Listy do wklejenia w gry LingoSpark.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Culture module: film, books, music, festivals, museums. Paste into LingoSpark games.

items.definitionEn: the people watching a play, film or concert
items.example: The audience clapped for a long time.

items.definitionEn: a show of music, dance or theatre in front of people
items.example: The school performance starts at six o'clock.

items.definitionEn: practice before the real show
items.example: We have a rehearsal every Tuesday after school.

items.definitionEn: the raised floor where actors or musicians perform
items.example: The singers walked onto the stage in the dark.

items.definitionEn: a public show of art or interesting objects
items.example: There is an exhibition of photographs in the town hall.

items.definitionEn: a building where paintings and art are shown
items.example: We spent an hour in the modern art gallery.

items.definitionEn: art made by shaping stone, wood or metal
items.example: The sculpture in the park is made of steel.

items.definitionEn: a long written story
items.example: This novel is about a girl who moves to London.

items.definitionEn: the person who wrote a book
items.example: The author signed copies of her book in the library.

items.definitionEn: the main events in a story
items.example: The plot of the film is easy to follow.

items.definitionEn: a person in a book, play or film
items.example: My favourite character is the funny younger sister.

items.definitionEn: one numbered part of a book
items.example: Read chapter five for homework.

items.definitionEn: an article that says if a film or book is good
items.example: The review in the paper was very positive.

items.definitionEn: music played in front of an audience, not a recording
items.example: Her first live concert was in a small club.

items.definitionEn: the words of a song
items.example: I do not understand the lyrics of this rap song.

items.definitionEn: a large group of musicians playing classical instruments
items.example: The school orchestra played at the Christmas concert.

items.definitionEn: a special event with music, film or food, often over days
items.example: The summer festival lasts three days.

items.definitionEn: something a community does every year in the same way
items.example: Sharing wafer is a Christmas tradition in Poland.

items.definitionEn: a public celebration with costumes, music and parades
items.example: People wear colourful costumes during the carnival.

items.definitionEn: explosions of colour in the sky for a celebration
items.example: We watched the fireworks at midnight.

items.definitionEn: special clothes for a play or celebration
items.example: She made her Halloween costume at home.

items.definitionEn: a work of art of the highest quality
items.example: Many people call that painting a masterpiece.

items.definitionEn: music in the style of Mozart or Chopin, often with an orchestra
items.example: He prefers classical music to pop.

items.definitionEn: stories about the future, space or invented science
items.example: This science fiction book is set on Mars.

items.definitionEn: a film or play that is meant to make you laugh
items.example: We watched a comedy after dinner.

items.definitionEn: a film that is meant to frighten you
items.example: I do not like a horror film before bed.

items.definitionEn: words at the bottom of the screen that translate the speech
items.example: Watch the English film with Polish subtitles first.

items.definitionEn: a short advert that shows scenes from a new film
items.example: The trailer made the film look more exciting than it was.

items.definitionEn: the place that sells tickets; how much money a film makes
items.example: Buy tickets at the box office or online.

items.definitionEn: a competition where people sing, dance or perform
items.example: She entered a talent show at school.

items.definitionEn: a famous person, often from film or music
items.example: A celebrity opened the new shopping centre.

items.definitionEn: a building that shows objects from history, science or art
items.example: The museum is free for students on Thursdays.

items.definitionEn: history, buildings and traditions passed down from the past
items.example: The old castle is part of the town's heritage.

items.definitionEn: a piece of paper or code that lets you enter an event
items.example: I bought a ticket for Saturday's match.

items.definitionEn: a short break in the middle of a play or concert
items.example: Ice cream is sold during the interval.

items.definitionEn: a book that sells in very large numbers
items.example: That crime novel was a bestseller last year.
